selection_basis: exact base and head SHA metadata
selection_rules: select exactly two eligible and previously unused cases from each default project
prefer changes with an independently executable boundary, state, dtype, parser, compile, or concurrency contract
include both apparently local repairs and potentially cross-cutting invariant changes
do not infer disposition from title sentiment, author identity, PR age, review, CI, state, or merge outcome

machine_policy.accept_rule: all blocking exact-contract checks pass; scope limitations remain explicit
machine_policy.revise_rule: the primary direction is demonstrated, no regression or integrity hazard remains, remediation is bounded, and an executable closure test exists
machine_policy.reject_rule: the primary claim is false or a semantic no-op, head regresses baseline, integrity is at risk, remediation is unbounded or design-level, closure testing is absent, or multiple residual failure families remain
machine_policy.unresolved_rule: required evidence could not be obtained for infrastructure reasons
